# RFC 9180 HPKE test vector

`base-x25519-hkdf-sha256-chacha20poly1305.json` is the minimal exact subset
needed by the conformance test from RFC 9180 Appendix A.2.1, Base mode with
X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20-Poly1305. It retains the recipient and ephemeral
key material plus the first encryption record (`Count-0`) from the single
matching upstream case; no value was generated by Talenro production code.

- RFC section: RFC 9180, Appendix A.2.1
- RFC: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180.html#appendix-A.2.1
- Upstream source: https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke/blob/5f503c564da00b0687b3de75f1dfbdfc4079ad31/test-vectors.json
- Upstream revision: `5f503c564da00b0687b3de75f1dfbdfc4079ad31` (`Add test vectors.`, 2021-05-24)

- Upstream `CONTRIBUTING.md` SHA-256: `c0875b5a20a34f970a4ead73f9c4e7392582d55d27708ee8c9ab9b67ebd2bb71`
